title: Approvals: a non-admin approver who opens an approval request from the Approvals inbox sees "You don't have access to Approval Request records" instead of the decision panel (regression from #27713)
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcUWM7N73xRVd64cyAE

QA-source: #28545 · approvals.account-app-entry · acceptance[3]

A non-admin approver can no longer open an approval request's record page from the Approvals inbox. The page shows the access-denied screen (`data-testid=record-access-denied`, "You don't have access to Approval Request records") with no Approve, Reject or Reassign. The same person can still decide through the inbox keyboard shortcuts (`a` / `r`), and the approvals door says they may act. `approvals.account-app-entry` acceptance[3] and acceptance[4] passed at `c4c515ad` (QA run #27481) and fail at `eeec88d1`. An independent second run reproduced the failure on two fresh loads, as RUNNER rule 7 requires.

## Reproduction (stock showcase at `eeec88d1`, Console built in-repo)
1. Boot the showcase: `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p PORT -d file:RUN/appr.db`.
2. As admin, `POST /api/v1/auth/organization/invite-member` `{"email":"x@example.test","role":"member"}`. X then calls `POST /api/v1/auth/sign-up/email`.
3. As admin, `POST /api/v1/data/sys_user_position` `{"user_id": X_ID, "position":"contributor", "organization_id": ORG}`, and again with `"position":"finance"`.
4. As X, `POST /api/v1/data/showcase_invoice` `{"name":"INV-1","account": ACTIVE_ACCOUNT_ID, "owner":"x@example.test"}` → 201.
5. As X, `PATCH /api/v1/data/showcase_invoice/ID` `{"status":"sent","issued_on":"2026-11-01"}`. This opens an approval request (`flow: showcase_invoice_signoff`) with X among `pending_approvers`.
6. Sign X in through the Console form. Open avatar › Profile › Inbox › Approvals and click the row. Also try a cold load of `/_console/apps/com.objectstack.account/sys_approval_request/record/AREQ_ID`, and a cold load of `/_console/apps/com.objectstack.account/component/approvals/inbox?request=AREQ_ID`.

**Expected** (acceptance[3]): the request page with the decision panel, as at `c4c515ad`. **Expected** (acceptance[4]): the `?request=` deep link shows that request.

**Actual, on all three paths:**
- The page's only read of the record is `POST /api/v1/data/sys_approval_request/AREQ_ID/page`, which answers **403** `{"code":"PERMISSION_DENIED","object":"sys_approval_request"}`. The page renders the access-denied screen with no Retry.
- The same user's `GET /api/v1/approvals/requests/AREQ_ID` answers **200** with `viewer: {can_act: true, …}`, but the page never calls it: 0 occurrences in the network log.
- The `?request=` link does replace itself with the record route, so the routing half of acceptance[4] holds; the landed page is the same lock screen.

**Ruled out:**
- a stale bundle: the served `/_console/` entry `assets/index-RFCp05oY.js` is byte-identical to `packages/console/dist`;
- a hydration race: screenshots at 3 s and 8 s are identical;
- the wrong persona: get-session shows the invited user, `isPlatformAdmin: false`;
- the automation input: cold loads need no click.

## Same root cause, for any approver, admin included
As an admin who is a pending approver, a cold load of `/_console/apps/com.objectstack.setup/sys_approval_request/record/AREQ_ID` gives `/page` → 200 and the page renders, but:
- there is **no Approve or Reject** (the ⋯ menu offers only Refresh / Add to favorites / Share);
- the "Waiting on" strip draws **one chip per character** of the approver ids: `i`, `S · holds 2 approver slots`, `B · holds 3 approver slots`, and so on.

Two runners saw this, under both the account and the setup app segments.

## Mechanism (read at `eeec88d1`)
- #27713 (`0027c4a2b8`, "one request opens a record page") made `RecordDetailView` take the opened record from `dataSource.getRecordPage(...)`. That is the generic data-API door `POST /api/v1/data/:object/:id/page` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`, the record-page effect at about lines 2202–2246; the record-load effect about 1180–1222 takes `page.record`; a 403 is classified `forbidden` and draws `record-access-denied`).
- `routeApprovalRecordReads` in `ui/apps/console/src/services/approvalRequestsDataSource.ts` overrides only `find` and `findOne`. `forwardToHost` passes every other member, `getRecordPage` included, straight to the host adapter (`ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts` `getRecordPage` → `client.data.recordPage`).
- The data door has no object-level read of `sys_approval_request` for these positions: `GET /api/v1/data/sys_approval_request/AREQ_ID` is also 403. So the request read that `GET /approvals/requests/:id` would serve never happens.
- Even when `/page` answers (admin), a data-door row carries no `viewer` block and serves `pending_approvers` as a comma-joined string, while the approvals door serves an array plus `viewer`. The decision actions' `record.viewer.can_act` predicates fail closed, and the chip renderer iterates the string character by character.

This is the same class as the closed 18.1.0 blocker #25228, reached through a new door. Not fixed by any open PR at the time of this run. #28470 (open) proposes adding more to the same record-page payload.
